Gives the channel that the sound of a movie plays on, for the channel commands: [ChannelVolume](ChannelVolume) (the same volume as [MovieVolume](MovieVolume)), [ChannelPan](ChannelPan), [ChannelBus](ChannelBus), [ChannelRadius](ChannelRadius) and [ChannelPlaying](ChannelPlaying). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
movie = OpenMovie("advert.mp4")
ChannelPan MovieChannel(movie), -1 ; only on the left speaker
```
@param movie  A movie handle from [OpenMovie](OpenMovie).
@returns The channel, `0` for a movie without sound or without a sound device. It stays the same until [CloseMovie](CloseMovie), across [SeekMovie](SeekMovie) and loops.
@gap The movie plays, pauses and stops its sound: [StopChannel](StopChannel), [PauseChannel](PauseChannel), [ResumeChannel](ResumeChannel) and [ChannelPitch](ChannelPitch) on it are runtime errors, and [StopAudioBus](StopAudioBus) leaves it alone.
